@pcbeingused333 is attempting to deploy a commit to the **Confident AI** Team on [Vercel](https://vercel.com).

A member of the Team first needs to [authorize it](https://vercel.com/git/authorize?team=Confident%20AI&slug=confident-ai&teamId=team_L1d4ojsSAF07As6tG9hvZoBn&type=github&job=%7B%22headInfo%22%3A%7B%22sha%22%3A%224fa4d5efa8ac0af0df762845b05b24f4ec7b3edf%22%7D%2C%22id%22%3A%22QmUv6UCE4kwA4WC6DuKTtWCEQ1RBuysPxtjXpmxqWq4ydn%22%2C%22org%22%3A%22confident-ai%22%2C%22prId%22%3A3271%2C%22repo%22%3A%22deepeval%22%7D).
Hi, a short ping on this one: CI is green except the Vercel deploy check, which only needs a team member to authorize it. Happy to adjust anything if you'd like it done differently.
